The Beskar brings something different to everyday carry, combining practical performance with a distinctive design that stands out. Its trailing point D2 blade delivers dependable edge retention and versatile slicing performance, with a working finish that fits the knife’s rugged character. Dark brown glass-filled nylon keeps the handle lightweight and durable, while an engravable steel inlay adds distinctive contrast with the option of a personal touch. Manual KVT ball bearings provide smooth deployment, and DuraLock delivers secure, intuitive operation. Finished with custom T8 handle screws, the Beskar packs everyday capability and unexpected detail into a uniquely styled folder.

  • Design-forward everyday carry with standout details and practical performance; trailing point blade provides a long cutting edge for smooth, efficient slicing
  • D2 tool steel offers a durable, sharp edge for work tasks; working finish hides even more hard use scratches than a stonewashed finish
  • Dark brown glass-filled nylon handle with steel tube spacers provides durable, lightweight construction; engravable steel inlay with working finish adds contrast
  • Manual KVT ball bearings provide smooth deployment; DuraLock offers secure, intuitive blade operation
  • Reversible deep-carry pocketclip is easily reversible for left/right carry

Note: Custom handle screws accept T8 Torx bits.
